C12ReleaseValidationRef.description: Opaque immutable C12-owned release/validation authority reference. Structural presence is necessary, not sufficient; trust must be resolved through the trusted C12 authority root.

C1Envelope.description: Exact discriminated union: payload_type is structurally bound to the corresponding payload schema.

CanonicalID.description: Lowercase RFC 9562 UUIDv4 canonical text; opaque, non-semantic, non-recycled.

ContentAddressRef.description: Authoritative content-address reference; human version labels are non-authoritative.

ContractRecord.description: C1 semantic validators require parent_instrument_ref to resolve to exactly one InstrumentRecord whose instrument_kind=DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT. For the same ContractID, parent_instrument_ref is immutable across versions.

ContractVenueAdmission.description: Semantic validator enforces contract.parent_instrument_id == listing.instrument_id. At a C4-defined state, duplicate active Contract->Listing admissions for the same endpoint tuple are invalid; C4 owns active-state determination and C11 owns persistence/idempotent coalescing.

ContractVenueAdmissionEffect.description: Semantic validator additionally enforces same-parent-Instrument invariant.

EconomicallyEquivalentToRelation.description: ECONOMICALLY_EQUIVALENT_TO is non-identity and same-kind on the currently frozen Instrument/Contract relation surface.

EntityRoleIdentityRelation.description: Instrument-to-Entity role relation. Graph-level minimum-cardinality requirements are enforced by semantic contract rules, not by per-record JSON Schema.

FungibleWithRelation.description: FUNGIBLE_WITH is non-identity and same-kind on the currently frozen Instrument/Contract relation surface.

IdentifierResolutionResult.description: CURRENT_ONLY is explicitly non-PIT and anchored by C4. TEMPORAL uses a C4-owned result ref and propagated reconstructability.

IdentityGraphResult.description: C1.04-facing result keeps active canonical state separate from visible non-active overlay. No local availability/effectivity/revision timestamps are serialized. CURRENT reconstructability=PIT_SAFE does not make the CURRENT anchor historical PIT evidence; historical reuse still requires HISTORICAL reconstruction or an explicit C4 reconstruction-equivalence proof.

ListingParentTransitionValidationInput.description: Cross-version C1 identity validation input. If before_record.ref == after_record.ref, instrument_ref and venue_ref must both remain unchanged.

ListingRecord.description: For the same ListingID, both instrument_ref and venue_ref are immutable across versions. A cross-canonical-Venue transfer requires a distinct new ListingID with explicit termination/create/predecessor-successor semantics. Non-identity tier/segment/display-label changes inside the same canonical Venue do not by themselves remint ListingID.

RegisteredIdentifierTarget.description: C1.02 registered-identifier target family; CorporateActionEvent is intentionally excluded.

ResolutionQueryBinding.description: Must echo the exact IdentifierResolutionQuery; if source query supplied expected_target_kind, this binding must carry the same value.

ResolutionSchemeBinding.description: C1 semantic hook: resolved_target_kind MUST be a member of the exact content-addressed SchemeDefinition.allowed_target_kinds and MUST satisfy that SchemeDefinition.category family.

SameVenueListingContinuityValidationInpu.description: Control for same-canonical-Venue continuity. Tier/segment/display-label metadata is intentionally outside ListingRecord identity fields; changing only such metadata does not force a new ListingID when instrument_ref and venue_ref remain the same.

SnapshotStableC2Ref.description: C1 boundary wrapper for a C2-owned ref whose semantic state is externally attested snapshot-stable. The wrapper does not define C2 internals and does not make self-asserted stability authoritative.

SpinoffEffect.description: Semantic validator additionally requires same-kind endpoint pair.

SuccessorEffect.description: Semantic validators additionally require target.kind == related_target.kind and target canonical ref != related_target canonical ref for PREDECESSOR_OF.
